races.name: Racing To School Celebrating 25 Years EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Qual) (C/D) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
British Stallion Studs John Dunlop EBF Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Pathein
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making his first start in 202 days under Daniel Muscutt, will benefit from the likely slow pace but needs to show improvement from his Kempton effort.

runners_data.name: Protection Act
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up performer returning from a 302-day break with perfect record on good going, but the long absence raises fitness concerns despite previous course-and-distance success.

runners_data.name: Pacific Avenue
runners_data.note: Class act with highest RPR and TS ratings who should benefit from the tactical setup, carrying headgear for the first time which could sharpen his focus.

runners_data.name: Allegresse
runners_data.note: Only front runner will get an uncontested lead but faces three superior-rated rivals who can all finish strongly off the likely steady pace.

races.paceDynamic: Allegresse will take the field along as the only confirmed front runner, setting a sustainable tempo without pressure from the three hold-up horses. Pathein, Protection Act, and Pacific Avenue will all settle behind, creating a slow-run affair where the pace will only quicken from the 3-furlong pole. This tactical setup heavily favours the hold-up horses who can unleash their finishing kicks, particularly those with proven ability to quicken off a steady gallop. The race shape decisively favours hold-up runners with strong finishing speed over the prominent runner.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pacific Avenue Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Pacific Avenue gets the right racing room turning for home
scenarios.body: His superior RPR of 113 and TS of 106 prove decisive when the pace lifts, with Charlie Appleby's runner having the class edge over his rivals. Recent good form on similar going gives him the tactical and ability advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Protection Act Returns
scenarios.trigger: If Protection Act's 302-day absence doesn't blunt his edge
scenarios.body: The George Boughey runner was impressive when winning last time and gets first run on his fresher rivals in the straight. His perfect record on good going and hold-up style suits this tactical setup perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pathein Gets Up Late
scenarios.trigger: If Pathein finds significant improvement from his Kempton second
scenarios.body: Daniel Muscutt's mount benefits most from the slow early pace and gets a dream run from the back of this small field. His 202-day break could have him primed for a big performance at a decent price.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Allegresse Surprises All
scenarios.trigger: If none of the hold-up horses can reel in Allegresse's sustained kick
scenarios.body: The front runner gets such an easy lead that he has plenty left for the finish despite his inferior ratings. Andrew Balding's charge benefits from controlling the pace completely without pressure.

watchPoints.text: Pacific Avenue must get clear racing room in the straight as he'll be coming from the back with the strongest finish
Protection Act's fitness after 302 days off - any signs of rustiness early will compromise his chances significantly
Allegresse's ability to sustain his kick when the hold-up horses challenge - his ratings suggest he's vulnerable late
Pathein's early positioning with Daniel Muscutt - needs to be handy enough to strike when the pace lifts
The pace through the first half-mile - if Allegresse goes too slow it plays into the hands of the closers even more

runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with course-and-distance advantage but carries top weight at 135lbs

runners_data.name: Spartan Arrow
runners_data.note: Recent Goodwood winner dropping in class with excellent 5f record under Hollie Doyle

runners_data.name: Rosario

runners_data.name: Trefor
runners_data.note: Classy hold-up horse returning from 230-day layoff but has excellent course record when fit

runners_data.name: Rhythm N Hooves
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner for in-form Saffie Osborne, good recent 5f form

runners_data.name: Lexington Blitz
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced improver with solid 5f record, well-positioned on light weight

runners_data.name: Clearpoint
runners_data.note: Reliable prominent runner with excellent recent consistency but limited 5f experience on turf

runners_data.name: King Of Light
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from long break, needs everything to fall right tactically

runners_data.name: Fandom
runners_data.note: Versatile hold-up performer but limited recent 5f form, apprentice Tyrese Cameron takes off 5lbs

runners_data.name: Rogue Enforcer
runners_data.note: Front-running tendencies but returning from 201-day absence, needs pace to develop

races.paceDynamic: Democracy Dilemma will likely set the pace from the front with minimal pressure, creating a sustainable tempo that suits prominent racers. The Robert Cowell-trained runner has the tactical speed to dictate terms, with most other pace-positive horses like Tropical Storm, Spartan Arrow, and Rhythm N Hooves likely to settle just behind rather than engage early. This controlled tempo will allow the prominent racers to travel comfortably before quickening, while the hold-up horses may struggle to pick up the pieces if the pace stays steady. The race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can position handily and have the speed to respond when Democracy Dilemma kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Prominent Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Democracy Dilemma sets uncontested fractions with prominent racers tracking smoothly
scenarios.body: The pace-setter dictates comfortable splits allowing the handy horses to travel before unleashing their turn of foot. Tropical Storm and Spartan Arrow benefit most from this tactical setup with their class edge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners challenge Democracy Dilemma early creating stronger gallop
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and sets up the hold-up horses perfectly for their late surge. Rosario and Trefor can capitalize on the pace collapse with their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Democracy Dilemma Wires
scenarios.trigger: If the leader maintains his advantage throughout with no serious challenge materializing
scenarios.body: The front-runner proves too tough from his ideal position, holding off all challengers in the final furlong. His recent course-and-distance form gives him the edge to complete the wire-to-wire victory.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes messy with multiple runners vying for position creating stop-start fractions
scenarios.body: The tactical nature creates opportunities for horses with tactical speed and good positioning. Clearpoint's consistent recent form and Rhythm N Hooves' versatility could exploit the scramble.

watchPoints.text: Democracy Dilemma could steal a march if he breaks cleanly and the field allows him uncontested lead
Tropical Storm's 27-day break and whether Rob Hornby can secure ideal prominent position from his draw
Trefor's fitness after 230-day layoff despite his excellent course record when ready
The pace development in the opening two furlongs will determine whether hold-up horses get their chance
Spartan Arrow's confidence after recent Goodwood success and ability to reproduce that winning form

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Daisy Warwick Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race) (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Kissmehoneyhoney
runners_data.note: Returns after 221 days off with a strong trainer record and the tactical speed to track Tattycoram perfectly from her prominent style

runners_data.name: Crepe Suzette
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with highest ratings returning from a break, needs the pace to develop into a proper test to showcase her class

runners_data.name: Tattycoram
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader who will control the tempo completely, perfectly positioned to dominate if uncontested early

runners_data.name: Incensed
runners_data.note: Recent runner in good form with prominent style, ideally placed to track the pace and challenge late under in-form connections

runners_data.name: Crystal Flyer
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 162 days with tongue-tie applied, needs strong pace to be effective from the rear

runners_data.name: Ryka
runners_data.note: High-class hold-up performer carrying 3lb penalty, has winning form on good going but needs genuine pace development

runners_data.name: Galaxy Star
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced improver with only recent Salisbury win to assess, hold-up style requires others to set up the race

runners_data.name: Coedana
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 196 days off, has winning form at this trip but inconsistent recent efforts raise questions

runners_data.name: Miss Wong
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with decent recent form on good going, needs strong early pace to bring stamina into play

races.paceDynamic: Tattycoram will lead from the start with no other confirmed pace-setters in this field, creating a controlled tempo that should suit her completely. The prominent runners Kissmehoneyhoney, Incensed and Coedana will track the leader in the first flight, while the strong contingent of hold-up horses including Crepe Suzette, Ryka, Crystal Flyer, Galaxy Star and Miss Wong will settle towards the rear. With just one leader setting a manageable gallop over this staying trip, the race sets up perfectly for the front-runner to dictate terms and kick clear when ready. This race shape strongly favours either the leader herself or the prominent racers who can track the pace without pressure and strike late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Tattycoram gets an uncontested lead and controls the tempo completely
scenarios.body: She can dictate every fraction and has the stamina reserves to repel all challengers in the straight. Her front-running style becomes unbeatable when she faces no early pressure over this trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and prominent runners get first run on the leader
scenarios.body: Kissmehoneyhoney or Incensed can sit in the perfect stalking position and produce a decisive move approaching the final furlong. They avoid the stamina test while getting ideal racing room.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Finish Required
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine and creates a proper stamina test
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their chance as the leaders tire, with Crepe Suzette and Ryka having the class to quicken late. Superior ratings tell over the final two furlongs when others have shot their bolt.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Tattycoram goes too slow and it becomes a tactical crawl
scenarios.body: The race turns into a sprint finish where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of position. Fresh horses returning from breaks like Kissmehoneyhoney and Crystal Flyer could benefit most.

watchPoints.text: Tattycoram could steal this completely if she gets soft sectionals early and no prominent runner applies pressure through the middle stages
Crystal Flyer has the tongue-tie on and returns fresh after 162 days which could spark significant improvement from her hold-up position
Kissmehoneyhoney's 221-day absence is notable but Haggas excels with horses returning from breaks and she has the tactical pace to be involved
The pace could collapse into a sprint if Tattycoram goes too conservatively, completely changing the complexion of the finish
Ryka's 3lb penalty reflects her recent good form but she needs the leaders to go quick enough to set up her late run

runners_data.name: Diligently

races.paceDynamic: Evening Saigon will likely lead from the gates with no other confirmed front runners in this field. Moving Force, Many A Star, Diligently and Kiss And Run all show prominent tendencies but are more likely to settle just behind rather than challenge for the early lead. This creates a controlled tempo scenario where Evening Saigon can dictate terms without early pressure. The tactical advantage lies with horses that can travel prominently and have the pace to respond when the race develops - prominent runners and strong hold-up horses with finishing kicks will be best positioned to capitalize on the likely honest but sustainable gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Evening Saigon gets an uncontested lead and maintains a steady tempo
scenarios.body: The front runner faces no early pressure and can time their effort perfectly, while prominent runners get first run on any faltering pace-setter. This sustained gallop suits horses who travel well in behind the speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Kick From Behind
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely steady and allows closers to unleash late runs
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get the perfect scenario with plenty of horse left for a telling finish, while early leaders may find themselves vulnerable to late challenges. The strong finishers can pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Tells
scenarios.trigger: If Moving Force or other prominent runners apply more pressure than expected early
scenarios.body: The pace quickens beyond Evening Saigon's comfort zone, creating opportunities for horses settling closer who can maintain their position without overracing. Those tracking the speed inherit the race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Suits Versatile
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses vie for prominent positions creating an uneven tempo
scenarios.body: The stop-start nature catches out one-dimensional runners while benefiting those with tactical speed and versatility. Experience and race-craft become decisive factors.

watchPoints.text: Evening Saigon must handle the responsibility of leading - any signs of over-racing or inability to settle could derail their chances
Moving Force faces enormous fitness test after 596 days off, market support would be significant given the lengthy absence
Dr Strangelove's hold-up style depends entirely on the pace being genuine enough to set up his finishing kick
Far Above Dream carries Hollie Doyle but the 201-day layoff is a concern despite the stable's excellent recent form
Watch for any prominent runners pressuring Evening Saigon early as this could change the entire complexion of the race

races.name: Fitzdares Dedicated Personal Betting Service Handicap

runners_data.name: Too Hot To Tango

runners_data.name: Kokoluna
runners_data.note: Sharp prominent type coming off a Goodwood win on similar going, with Eve Johnson Houghton's yard in decent form.

runners_data.name: Lux Aeterna
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won last time at Salisbury and should relish the likely steady pace to unleash a trademark late run.

runners_data.name: Bridge Of Eagles
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from a 163-day break which raises fitness concerns despite his strong style profile for this race shape.

runners_data.name: Veritable
runners_data.note: Lone front runner who will dictate terms but carries the burden of doing the donkey work for the Gosden yard.

runners_data.name: Foothold

runners_data.name: Morbeh

races.paceDynamic: Veritable stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will set a sustainable pace without pressure from the gate. The prominent runners Too Hot To Tango and Kokoluna will track just behind, but neither has shown aggressive early pace to challenge Veritable's lead. This creates a comfortable tempo that allows the hold-up horses Lux Aeterna, Bridge Of Eagles, Foothold and Morbeh to settle and build their runs from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can capitalize on the steady gallop and finish with late runs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Veritable sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays moderate
scenarios.body: The hold-up quartet gets ideal conditions to settle and unleash finishing kicks, with Lux Aeterna and Foothold best positioned to capitalize. The sustainable pace leaves plenty in the tank for those coming from behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Too Hot To Tango or Kokoluna applies early pressure to Veritable
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favours horses with tactical speed who can position prominently. Kokoluna's recent Goodwood win gives her the edge in this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Veritable secures a soft lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The front runner capitalizes on the uncontested pace to build an unassailable advantage. The hold-up horses find the gap too big despite their late flourish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is extremely slow and it becomes a dash from the furlong pole
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where early position matters most. The prominent runners and any hold-up horse with tactical pace benefit.

watchPoints.text: Bridge Of Eagles returning after 163 days off - fitness levels unknown despite favourable race shape
Veritable getting an uncontested lead early - if no pressure applied he could steal a march
Too Hot To Tango and Kokoluna failing to track the leader closely - would hand Veritable a soft lead
Foothold's positioning in the early stages - needs to settle to utilize his finishing kick effectively
The pace through the first half-mile - if too slow it becomes a sprint finish that changes all calculations

races.paceDynamic: Scarlet Moon is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely getting an uncontested lead with soft fractions through the early stages. The prominent runners Diamond Bay, Market House, Gallivanted, and Cruden will settle in behind but none are natural pace pressers, allowing Scarlet Moon to control the tempo. In the straight, the hold-up pair Golden Garden and Autumn's Breeze will launch their challenges from the rear, but may find the steady pace hasn't set up ideal circumstances for closing finishers. This race shape clearly favors front runners and prominent racers who can track the pace and strike when the tempo lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Scarlet Moon gets soft early fractions and maintains control
scenarios.body: Watson's mare will dictate ideal splits and prove hard to peg back when asked for effort. Her class edge at this level combined with tactical advantage makes her very hard to catch.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and kicks hard late
scenarios.body: Market House or Gallivanted can sit close enough to pounce when the tempo lifts in the straight. Their superior finishing kicks will tell when the race becomes a sprint.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Challenge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is stronger than expected through the middle stages
scenarios.body: Golden Garden and Autumn's Breeze will benefit from a more genuine gallop that stretches the field. Their closing style becomes more potent with proper pace setup.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Tactical Mess
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses go forward early creating unexpected pace pressure
scenarios.body: The race splinters with several trying to lead or press, creating gaps for late runners. Fair Dinkum or Arcturus Flame could benefit from the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Scarlet Moon's fitness after 231-day layoff - any signs of blowing up or lacking stamina in final furlong would be crucial
Market House with 5lb claimer Mason Paetel in tactical battle - inexperienced rider could cost vital lengths at crucial moments
Golden Garden's early positioning from stall - if forced wide or caught in traffic early it kills any chance from hold-up style
The pace through opening half-mile - if genuinely strong it transforms race dynamics and brings closers into serious contention
Gallivanted's jumping from stalls - has been slow away recently and cannot afford to give leaders too much start
